timeline.tag: Chronicles of Sweetness • 8,000 BC to Present
timeline.title: The Ancient Odyssey Of Cane
timeline.sub: Trace how a wild Pacific grass became the world's most cherished botanical elixir across six millennia of human civilization.

milestones.title: Domestication of Saccharum
milestones.desc: Indigenous farmers in Papua New Guinea first cultivate wild Saccharum robustum, chewing raw stalks for pure natural sustenance.

milestones.title: First Crystal Sugar & Ayurveda
milestones.desc: Indian scholars discover how to crystallize cane juice into 'Khanda' (the origin of the word candy) and document its cooling digestive benefits in Ayurvedic texts.

milestones.title: The Golden Age of Cane Mills
milestones.desc: Persian and Arab agronomists engineer sophisticated water-powered crushing mills, introducing cold sugarcane extraction to Egypt, Sicily, and Spain.

milestones.title: Global Maritime Expansion
milestones.desc: Sugarcane seedlings cross the Atlantic, flourishing in fertile volcanic soils and becoming the cornerstone of international botanical trade.

milestones.title: The Cane House Renaissance
milestones.desc: We revive the forgotten art of raw, cold-pressed sugarcane juice — unadulterated, unpasteurized, and freshly poured for London's communities.

history.title: History Of Sugarcane
history.sub: Originating in New Guinea, sugarcane spread across Asia, the Middle East, Europe and the world. It played a vital role in trade, economies and cultures for centuries.

life_cycle.title: Life Cycle Of Sugarcane
life_cycle.sub: From fertile volcanic soils to the final fresh-pressed London pour — explore every biological stage of the ancient Saccharum officinarum plant.

items.label: Planting
items.headline: Sett Planting & Soil Preparation
items.fact: Selected 2-3 eye cuttings in fertile furrows
items.desc: Prime mature cane cuttings (setts) are planted horizontally in deep, nutrient-rich volcanic compost beds, sprouting tender roots and vigorous green shoots.
bullets: Selected 2-3 eye mature cuttings
Planted in fertile, well-drained volcanic soil
Hydrated with pure natural mountain runoff

items.label: Growing
items.headline: Months of Sun and Soil
items.fact: 6 to 8 healthy secondary shoots per plant
items.desc: The cane rises up to 4 metres tall over 6–12 months, drinking in tropical sunlight and rain. Farmers tend the crop naturally with zero synthetic chemicals.
bullets: Grows up to 4 metres tall under steady sun
6–12 month natural botanical growing cycle
Zero synthetic fertilisers or pesticides used

items.label: Harvesting
items.headline: Peak Sweetness Dawn Harvest
items.fact: Hand-cut at soil level to preserve root ratoon
items.desc: Stalks are cut close to ground level by hand during cool dawn hours, locking in maximum natural sucrose content, rich minerals, and crisp freshness.
bullets: Harvested at peak 18°–22° Brix sweetness
Hand-harvested at soil line to protect living roots
Living ratoon regrows organically for the next cycle

items.label: Transport
items.headline: Cold-Chain Farm-to-Bar Logistics
items.fact: Direct traceability to sustainable family farms
items.desc: Freshly bundled stalks are transported under temperature-monitored conditions without storage delays, preserving live botanical enzymes.
bullets: Transported swiftly within hours of morning harvest
Zero chemical waxes or synthetic preservatives
Direct farm-to-glass traceable botanical integrity

items.label: Pressing
items.headline: Cold-Press Live Extraction
items.desc: Stalks pass through industrial-grade stainless steel calibrated rollers, gently drawing out 100% pure raw botanical juice with zero friction heat.
bullets: Single-pass cold crush technology
Raw, unheated & unpasteurised living juice
100% natural — zero added water, sugar, or syrups

items.label: Zero Waste
items.headline: Full-Circle Fiber Upcycling
items.fact: Bagasse fiber returns to nature as nutrient mulch
items.desc: Residual crushed fiber (bagasse) is collected and repurposed into organic soil mulch, biodegradable packaging, and renewable biofuel.
bullets: 100% of the sugarcane plant is utilized
Bagasse upcycled into compost & eco packaging
Zero landfill waste throughout the production loop

items.fact: Ancient wellness drink poured in modern London

uses.title: FROM TRADITION TO BIOFUEL: The Versatile Cane
uses.sub: Sugarcane is one of nature's most extraordinary renewable crops. Almost zero percent goes to waste — every single part from sweet nectar to fibrous stalk fuels civilization.

items.title: Sacred Rituals & Harvest Celebrations
items.desc: For millennia, raw sugarcane stalks have formed the auspicious centerpiece of harvest festivals across Asia and the Tropics — from Thai & Indian harvest celebrations (Pongal, Lohri, Chhath Puja) to traditional wedding blessing mandaps symbolising eternal prosperity and sweet beginnings.
items.fact: Ancient Vedic hymns refer to sugarcane as 'Ikshu', the divine plant of happiness and celebratory vitality.

items.title: Raw Cold-Pressed Botanical Elixir
items.desc: Freshly extracted through food-grade rollers without thermal pasteurization or chemical additives. Delivers an immediate flood of raw bioavailable electrolytes, natural sucrose, active enzymes, and cooling cellular hydration.
items.fact: Carries a low glycemic index (~43) because its natural sucrose is bound to living plant polyphenols.

items.title: Artisanal Jaggery & Molasses (Gur)
items.desc: Simmered in wide iron vats over wood fires to create unrefined whole cane sugar, jaggery, and blackstrap molasses. Unlike white refined sugar, whole jaggery preserves iron, potassium, magnesium, and essential trace minerals.
items.fact: Traditional Ayurvedic practitioners prescribe warm jaggery to cleanse the respiratory tract and soothe the lungs.

items.title: Green Bio-Ethanol & Clean Automotive Fuel
items.desc: Fermenting sugarcane molasses yields high-purity bio-ethanol used worldwide as a clean, high-octane biofuel. It displaces fossil fuels, slashing greenhouse gas emissions by up to 90% compared to conventional petroleum gasoline.
items.fact: Brazil's sugarcane ethanol fleet has prevented over 600 million tons of carbon emissions since 2003.

items.title: Biomass Cogeneration & Clean Grid Electricity
items.desc: After extracting the juice, the dry fibrous cane stalks (bagasse) are fed into high-efficiency cogeneration boilers. This generates clean thermal steam and green electricity that powers the entire mill and exports surplus renewable power to local town grids.
items.fact: A standard modern sugarcane facility generates 100% of its own energy with excess power fed to public utilities.

items.title: 100% Compostable Bagasse Tableware & Packaging
items.desc: Crushed bagasse fiber is thermo-formed into sturdy, grease-resistant food containers, bowls, cups, and takeaway boxes. They are 100% plastic-free, PFAS-free, and fully biodegrade in backyard compost within 60 to 90 days.
items.fact: Replaces petroleum-based Styrofoam and plastic containers with a renewable byproduct that returns to the soil.

items.title: Tree-Free Paper & Natural Cardboard
items.desc: Because sugarcane stalk fibers are rich in high-tensile cellulose, they make exquisite, silky unbleached paper and corrugated packaging without cutting down a single forest tree. Saves millions of old-growth trees every year.
items.fact: Sugarcane reaches maturity in 12 months compared to 20–30 years for softwood pulp trees.

items.title: Pressmud Bio-Fertiliser & Soil Conditioner
items.desc: The mineral-rich residue filtered during juice clarification is composted with organic matter into 'Pressmud' bio-fertiliser. Packed with phosphorus, calcium, and beneficial soil microbes, it revitalizes agricultural soils naturally.
items.fact: Pressmud acts as an organic moisture retainer, reducing irrigation water requirements by up to 25%.

items.title: Plant-Based Biopolymers & Bio-PE
items.desc: Sugarcane ethanol can be synthesized into Bio-based Polyethylene (Green PE), a renewable biopolymer identical in performance to traditional plastics but made from 100% atmospheric carbon captured by the growing plant.
items.fact: For every kilogram of green sugarcane plastic produced, over 3 kg of atmospheric CO2 is permanently sequestered.

culture.sub: A part of festivals, traditions, rituals and celebrations. It connects generations and brings people together.

nutritional_alchemy.title: The Mineral Alchemy Of Cane
nutritional_alchemy.sub: Unlike refined white sugar which is chemically stripped of all nutrients, 100% raw cold-pressed cane juice is an unrefined whole-plant tonic rich in vital electrolytes.

spotlight.title: 100% LIVING PLANT WATER
spotlight.summary: Unlike processed table sugar that causes rapid insulin spikes, raw sugarcane delivers organic glucose and fructose naturally bound to bioavailable plant minerals, phenolic flavonoids, and soluble fibers for sustained cellular hydration.

storage_guide.title: How To Store & Enjoy
storage_guide.sub: Cold-pressed raw sugarcane juice contains live botanical enzymes. Follow our artisanal handling rules for peak flavour.

tips.title: Keep Strictly Chilled
tips.desc: Store between 2°C and 5°C. Raw cane contains zero thermal pasteurization, so chill immediately.

tips.title: Gentle Shake Before Pour
tips.desc: Natural micro-plant fiber and mineral salts settle at the bottom. A gentle swirl reunites the full body.

tips.title: Enjoy Within 48 Hours
tips.desc: Best consumed within 24–48 hours of pressing for peak enzymatic vibrancy and crisp botanical aroma.

tips.title: Pair With Citrus & Spice
tips.desc: Enhance with a squeeze of fresh lime, crushed ginger, or a sprig of garden mint for an authentic London pour.

items.question: Is sugarcane juice safe for diabetics?
items.answer: In moderation, and best discussed with your doctor - it is naturally sweet with no added sugar, but still a source of natural sugars.

items.question: Does sugarcane juice have calories?
items.answer: Yes, naturally - it's a whole-plant drink, not a diet product, but it has none of the artificial additives found in most soft drinks.

items.question: How is your juice different?
items.answer: Pressed fresh in front of you, from cane sourced the same day - never bottled, never stored.

items.question: Is your juice 100% natural?
items.answer: Yes - no added sugar, colours, or preservatives, ever.

items.question: How should I store it?
items.answer: It's best enjoyed fresh, right after pressing - like any fresh juice, it doesn't keep well overnight.

closing.sub: Sugarcane is more than a crop. It is a legacy. A gift from nature. A symbol of life. At The Cane House, we honour this timeless sweetness, and bring it to you - fresh, pure, and full of goodness.
